## Review of the brief

The brief is clear on the problem and the goals. Three points need an answer before the PRD can be written.

- **Scope:** v1 scope is listed, but nothing says which of the workflows must work offline.
- **Users:** the brief names the users but not how many people will use the app at the same time.
- **Existing assets:** the spreadsheet the team uses today is mentioned, but not whether its data must be imported.

questions.question: Which workflows must keep working without a network connection?
How many people will use the app at the same time, at most?
Does the data in the current spreadsheet need to be imported into v1?
